## Overview

A menu is a short list of actions that floats above the page from a trigger and closes after one choice. Common triggers:

- an overflow ⋮ button on a booking card
- a "Sort by" dropdown button
- a right-click on a trip row

The same menu serves mobile and web.

Every row has the same shape: an optional leading icon, a label with an optional supporting line, and an optional trailing part. The trailing part is one of three things:

- **Meta.** A keyboard shortcut on web, or a current value.
- **Chevron.** The row opens a submenu.
- **Check.** The chosen option of a single-select menu.

Rows can be grouped under a section header, and groups are separated by a divider. A destructive row, such as Cancel booking or Delete trip, is red and sits last, after a divider.

Two densities:

- **Comfortable** is the default, and the only density allowed on touch screens. A one-line row is 48 tall.
- **Compact** is for pointer-first web menus. A one-line row is 36 tall.

The component is four Figma sets:

- **Menu / Item** is one row.
- **Menu / Section header** names a group of rows.
- **Menu / Divider** separates groups.
- **Menu** is the panel that holds them. It has a white surface, a hairline border, the overlay shadow and rounded corners: 16 in Comfortable and 12 in Compact.

### When to use something else

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Picking a value for a form field, where the choice stays visible in the field | A select or dropdown field |
| The options are the main content of the screen, or there are more than about 12 | A list, a picker screen, or a bottom sheet on mobile |
| Two to five mutually exclusive views that should stay visible | Segmented control or Tab |
| A choice that needs a confirmation, a form or an explanation | A dialog or a bottom sheet |
| An iOS or Android system action sheet, with Cancel at the bottom | The platform action sheet, until the Cosmos Bottom sheet exists |

### Composition

- **Menu / Item** carries all its trailing parts as plain layers toggled by boolean properties, not as a nested Trailing set. Changing a row State, Intent or Density therefore keeps every text and toggle override. That avoids the List gap where nested overrides reset.
- **Menu** holds instances of Menu / Section header, five Menu / Item rows (Items 4 and 5 hidden as spares), Menu / Divider and a destructive Menu / Item.
  - Each part has a Show toggle on the Menu itself, so rows, the header and the divider can be shown or hidden from the inspector with the Menu selected.
  - All eight parts are exposed nested instances. Their Label, icon, meta, check, chevron and State appear in the same inspector, so you never have to drill into a row.
  - A Density change on the Menu keeps every row label and toggle; the rows follow the new density.
  - Set a row's State before its text and toggles.
- **Icon / plus** (`55:11`) is the placeholder leading glyph. **Icon / chevron-right** (`55:5`) is the submenu chevron and **Icon / check** (`55:14`) the selection check.
- Six glyphs were added for this component, all Material Symbols Rounded, weight 300, grade 0, optical size 24:
  - **Icon / share** (`780:28`)
  - **Icon / bookmark** (`780:31`)
  - **Icon / delete** (`780:34`)
  - **Icon / edit** (`780:37`)
  - **Icon / content-copy** (`780:40`)
  - **Icon / drive-file-move** (`780:43`)
- The examples also use **Button** (set `58:202`) as the Sort by trigger.
- _Decorative children: 1 (Focus ring). It is documented under Structure._

## API

> `State` is design-only except `Disabled` and `Open`. `Hover`, `Pressed` and `Focus` exist so a mock can show them. In code they are `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible` (or the roving highlight, see Behaviour). `Open` is a submenu row whose submenu is showing, `aria-expanded="true"` in code.

### Menu (the panel)

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` | element | (element) | – | Required. The button that opens the menu and gets focus back when it closes. |
| `open` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Controlled or uncontrolled. |
| `density` | enum | comfortable \| compact | `comfortable` | Applies to every row and header in the menu. Compact is web only. |
| `placement` | enum | bottom-start \| bottom-end \| top-start \| top-end \| right-start (submenu) | `bottom-start` | Flips when there is no room. See Behaviour. |
| `selectionMode` | enum | none \| single | `none` | `single` makes the rows radio items with a trailing check. One menu, or one group, holds one choice. |
| `value` | string | (item id) | – | The checked row when `selectionMode` is `single`. |
| `onOpenChange` | callback | (open) => void | – | |

### Menu item

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | (string) | – | Required. A verb first for actions ("Share booking"), a noun for options ("Price: low to high"). Sentence case. |
| `supportingText` | string | (string) | – | Optional second line that explains the action. Use it rarely. |
| `icon` | icon | (icon) | – | Optional leading glyph. Use icons on every row of a group or on none, so the labels line up. |
| `meta` | string | (string) | – | Keyboard shortcut (`⌘D`) or a short value. Hidden on touch. |
| `submenu` | Menu | (menu) | – | Shows the chevron. A row with a submenu never runs an action itself. |
| `checked` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Single-select only. Shows the check. |
| `destructive` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Red label and icon. Use it for actions that delete, cancel or cannot be undone. |
| `disabled` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | The row stays in place, dimmed. |
| `onSelect` | callback | () => void | – | Runs the action and closes the whole menu. |

### Figma-only properties

| Set | Figma property | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item | `Intent` | VARIANT | Neutral | Neutral, Destructive |
| Item | `Density` | VARIANT | Comfortable | Comfortable, Compact |
| Item | `State` | VARIANT | Default | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Open. Open exists for Neutral only. 22 variants in all. |
| Item | `Label`, `Supporting text`, `Meta` | TEXT | Placeholder copy | |
| Item | `Show leading icon` | BOOLEAN | `true` | |
| Item | `Show supporting text`, `Show meta`, `Show chevron`, `Show check` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Show one trailing part at most. Destructive rows have no chevron or check. |
| Item | `Leading icon` | INSTANCE_SWAP | Icon / plus | Preferred values include the six glyphs above. |
| Section header | `Density` | VARIANT | Comfortable | `Label` TEXT property. |
| Divider | `Density` | VARIANT | Comfortable | |
| Menu | `Density` | VARIANT | Comfortable | Comfortable, Compact. 2 variants. |
| Menu | `Show section header`, `Show item 1`, `Show item 2`, `Show item 3`, `Show divider`, `Show destructive item` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Show or hide each part from the Menu. |
| Menu | `Show item 4`, `Show item 5` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Spare rows. |

Every variant ships placeholder copy only. Realistic copy lives in the `Menu examples` frame (`782:96`).

| # | Configuration | Notes |

## Behaviour

- **Opening.** A tap or click on the trigger opens the menu. On web, Enter, Space and Down arrow also open it, with focus on the first row; Up arrow opens it with focus on the last row. A right-click or long-press opens a context menu at the pointer.
- **Placement.**
  - The panel opens `menu/offset` below the trigger and aligns to its start edge; an overflow ⋮ menu aligns to the end edge.
  - When there is no room below, it flips above. It always keeps an 8 px margin from the viewport edge.
  - Past the available height it scrolls inside, and the panel never grows past the viewport.
- **Width.** The panel hugs its widest row between `menu/min-width` (200) and `menu/max-width` (320). Longer labels wrap to a second line. In Figma the panel starts 258 wide (a 240 row plus padding and border); resize it and the rows follow.
- **Closing.** Choosing an action closes the whole menu, submenus included. So do Esc, a click or tap outside, Tab, and scrolling the page on mobile. Focus returns to the trigger, except when Tab moves it on.
- **Highlight.** On web one row is highlighted at a time, by the pointer or by the arrow keys. The pointer and keyboard share the highlight, so the fill is the same. A keyboard highlight adds the focus ring, because the grey fill alone is 1.09:1 against the panel.
- **Destructive rows** take a red tint on hover, focus and press. They are the last row, set apart by a divider. Deleting or cancelling something the user cannot get back still needs a confirmation dialog after the menu.
- **Single-select.** The chosen row shows the check; its label does not change colour. Choosing a row moves the check and closes the menu. The trigger should show the current value ("Sort by: Price").
- **Submenus** (web).
  - A submenu opens `menu/offset` to the right of its parent row, with its first row level with the parent. It flips to the left when there is no room.
  - Hover opens it after a short intent delay, about 100 ms, and a diagonal pointer path to the submenu keeps it open. Right arrow, Enter or Space open it too.
  - Left arrow or Esc closes it and returns the highlight to the parent row, which shows `State=Open` while the submenu is showing.
  - Keep submenus one level deep.
- **Mobile.**
  - Use Comfortable only, with no hover state and no shortcuts.
  - A tap on a submenu row replaces the menu contents with the submenu, with a back row at the top, or moves to a bottom sheet. Do not fly out a second panel on a phone.
- **Disabled rows** keep their place, so the user learns the action exists. They are dimmed and do nothing. On web they stay reachable by arrow keys, so a screen reader can announce them.
- **Content.** Keep each group to about 7 rows and the menu to about 12. Labels are sentence case, start with a verb for actions, and never end with a full stop.

### Motion (not tokenised yet)

- **Open:** the panel fades in and scales from 0.96 to 1 over 150 ms with standard easing, `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`. The scale origin is the corner nearest the trigger.
- **Close:** the panel fades out in 100 ms.
- **Highlight:** the highlight changes with no transition.
- **Reduced motion:** the panel appears and disappears with no scale.

## Structure

### Anatomy

```text
Menu (component set · 781:4119) · vertical · padding · border · radius-{density} · shadow/overlay · min-width to max-width
├─ Section header (instance · Menu / Section header) · exposed · Show section header
├─ Item 1 … Item 5 (instances · Menu / Item) · exposed · Show item 1 … Show item 5 (4 and 5 off)
├─ Divider (instance · Menu / Divider) · exposed · Show divider
└─ Destructive item (instance · Menu / Item, Intent=Destructive) · exposed · Show destructive item

Menu / Item (component set · 781:231) · horizontal · padding-x, padding-y · gap · min-height · item-radius-{density}
├─ Leading icon (instance · Icon / plus) · leading-icon-size · Show leading icon, Leading icon swap
├─ Main (frame · fills the width · gap-text-trailing)
│  ├─ Text (frame · vertical · gap-text)
│  │  ├─ Label (text)
│  │  └─ Supporting text (text) · Show supporting text
│  ├─ Meta (text) · Show meta
│  ├─ Chevron (instance · Icon / chevron-right) · trailing-icon-size · Show chevron · Neutral only
│  └─ Check (instance · Icon / check) · trailing-icon-size · Show check · Neutral only
└─ Focus ring (rectangle) · decorative · absolute, on the row edge, stroke inside · State=Focus only

Menu / Section header (component set · 781:3971)
└─ Label (text) · padding-x equal to the row padding-x, so it lines up with the labels

Menu / Divider (component set · 781:3972) · vertical · divider-spacing above and below
└─ Line (rectangle) · divider-width tall · fills the width
```

The rows are inset from the panel edge by `menu/padding-comfortable` or `menu/padding-compact`, so the row highlight is a rounded shape inside the panel rather than a full-bleed band. The focus ring sits on the row edge with its stroke inside. The panel padding keeps it clear of the panel border.

### Dimensions

| Property | Comfortable | Compact | Token |
|---|---|---|---|
| Panel padding, every side | 8 | 4 | `menu/padding-comfortable`, `menu/padding-compact` |
| Panel width | 200 to 320 | 200 to 320 | `menu/min-width`, `menu/max-width` |
| Panel radius | 16 | 12 | `menu/radius-comfortable`, `menu/radius-compact` |
| Panel border | 1 | 1 | `menu/border-width` |
| Space between trigger and panel, and panel and submenu | 4 | 4 | `menu/offset` |
| Row min height, one line | 48 | 36 | `menu/item-min-height-comfortable`, `menu/item-min-height-compact` |
| Row padding left and right | 12 | 8 | `menu/item-padding-x-comfortable`, `menu/item-padding-x-compact` |
| Row padding top and bottom | 12 | 8 | `menu/item-padding-y-comfortable`, `menu/item-padding-y-compact` |
| Row radius | 12 | 8 | `menu/item-radius-comfortable`, `menu/item-radius-compact` |
| Gap between leading icon and text | 12 | 8 | `menu/gap-comfortable`, `menu/gap-compact` |
| Gap between text and trailing part | 16 | 12 | `menu/gap-text-trailing-comfortable`, `menu/gap-text-trailing-compact` |
| Gap between label and supporting text | 2 | 2 | `menu/gap-text` |
| Leading icon | 20 | 16 | `menu/leading-icon-size-comfortable`, `menu/leading-icon-size-compact` |
| Chevron and check | 20 | 16 | `menu/trailing-icon-size-comfortable`, `menu/trailing-icon-size-compact` |
| Label type | 16 / 24 regular | 14 / 20 regular | `label/large/regular`, `label/medium/regular` |
| Supporting text and meta type | 14 / 22 regular | 12 / 18 regular | `body/medium/regular`, `body/small/regular` |
| Section header padding top / bottom | 8 / 4 | 4 / 2 | `menu/section-header-padding-top-*`, `menu/section-header-padding-bottom-*` |
| Section header type | 12 / 16 bold | 12 / 16 bold | `label/small/bold` |
| Divider line | 1 | 1 | `menu/divider-width` |
| Space above and below a divider | 8 | 4 | `menu/divider-spacing-comfortable`, `menu/divider-spacing-compact` |
| Focus ring | 2, inside the row edge, radius 12 | 2, inside the row edge, radius 8 | `menu/focus-ring-width`, `menu/item-radius-comfortable`, `menu/item-radius-compact` |

Row heights:

| Lines | Comfortable | Compact |
|---|---|---|
| Label only | 12 + 24 + 12 = 48 | 8 + 20 + 8 = 36 |
| Label and supporting text | 12 + 24 + 2 + 22 + 12 = 72 | 8 + 20 + 2 + 18 + 8 = 56 |

The label uses the label style, not body, because a row is a single-line control label with tight leading. Label plus padding lands exactly on the 48 and 36 minimums. The label starts 8 + 12 = 20 in from the panel edge in Comfortable, and 4 + 8 = 12 in Compact. The section header uses the same inset, so it lines up with the labels.

## Color

Token names follow `menu/{element}-{intent}-{state}`, with the intent left out for Neutral.

**Neutral rows**

| State | Row fill | Label | Supporting, meta | Leading icon | Chevron | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default | transparent | `text-primary` #0A0A0A | `text-secondary` #525252 | `icon-secondary` #525252 | `icon-tertiary` #737373 | `icon-brand` #0067E8 |
| Hover, Open | `bg-fill-hover` #F5F5F5 | same | same | same | same | same |
| Focus | `bg-fill-hover` #F5F5F5, plus the ring | same | same | same | same | same |
| Pressed | `bg-fill-pressed-strong` #E5E5E5 | same | same | same | same | same |
| Disabled | transparent | `text-disabled` #A1A1A1 | `text-disabled` #A1A1A1 | `icon-disabled` #A1A1A1 | `icon-disabled` #A1A1A1 | `icon-disabled` #A1A1A1 |

**Destructive rows**

| State | Row fill | Label | Leading icon |
|---|---|---|---|
| Default | transparent | `text-warning` #C10007 | `icon-warning` #C10007 |
| Hover, Focus | `bg-surface-warning-hover` #FFE2E2 (Focus adds the ring) | `text-warning-on-bg-surface-hover` #9F0712 | `icon-warning-on-bg-surface-hover` #9F0712 |
| Pressed | `bg-surface-warning-pressed` #FFC9C9 | `text-warning-on-bg-surface-pressed` #82181A | `icon-warning-on-bg-surface-pressed` #82181A |
| Disabled | transparent | `text-disabled` #A1A1A1 | `icon-disabled` #A1A1A1 |

Supporting text and meta on a destructive row keep the neutral `text-secondary`.

**Panel and parts**

| Element | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Panel | `menu/bg` → `bg-surface-secondary` | #FFFFFF |
| Panel border | `menu/border` → `border-secondary` | #E5E5E5 |
| Panel shadow | `shadow.overlay` (Figma effect style `shadow/overlay`) | 0 4 8 and 0 8 24, neutral 950 at 8% and 12% |
| Section header | `menu/section-header-text` → `text-secondary` | #525252 |
| Divider | `menu/divider` → `border-secondary` | #E5E5E5 |
| Focus ring | `menu/focus-ring` → `border-focus` | #0681FF |

The panel is `bg-surface-secondary`, the white container that the README pairs with menus. On a white page it is the same colour as the canvas, and the border and shadow separate it. Pressed uses `bg-fill-pressed-strong`, the same as List, because the subtle pressed grey matches hover and a press would show no change.

This component adds no semantic roles. It adds two primitive widths, `spacing.200` and `spacing.320`, because the semantic space scale stops at 64.

## Accessibility

### Contrast

| Pair | Ratio | Required | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Label #0A0A0A on white / hover / pressed | 19.80 / 18.16 / 15.72:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Supporting text, meta and section header #525252 on white / hover / pressed | 7.81 / 7.17 / 6.20:1 | 4.5:1 | Pass |
| Leading icon #525252 on white / pressed | 7.81 / 6.20:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Chevron #737373 on white / hover / pressed | 4.74 / 4.35 / 3.76:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Check #0067E8 on white / hover / pressed | 5.12 / 4.69 / 4.06:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Destructive label and icon #C10007 on white | 6.42:1 | 4.5:1 | Pass |
| Destructive hover #9F0712 on #FFE2E2 | 6.85:1 | 4.5:1 | Pass |
| Destructive pressed #82181A on #FFC9C9 | 6.90:1 | 4.5:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring #0681FF on white / on the hover grey | 3.76 / 3.44:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Panel border #E5E5E5 on white | 1.26:1 | – | Decorative; the shadow and the content separate the panel |
| Hover fill #F5F5F5 on white | 1.09:1 | – | Not relied on: keyboard focus adds the ring |
| Disabled text #A1A1A1 on white | 2.58:1 | – | Exempt: inactive (1.4.3) |

Destructive meaning is carried by the label text ("Cancel booking"), not by the red alone (1.4.1). Selection is carried by the check and by `aria-checked`, not by colour.

### Semantics

| | Web | iOS / VoiceOver | Android / TalkBack |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trigger | `button` with `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` | `Menu { … } label: { … }`, or a button with `.contextMenu`; VoiceOver adds "pop-up button" | `IconButton` or `Button` with `Modifier.semantics { role = Role.DropdownList }` or a `contentDescription` such as "More options" |
| Panel | `role="menu"` with `aria-labelledby` on the trigger. Focus moves into it on open | System menu, announced as a menu | `DropdownMenu`, announced as a pop-up window |
| Action row | `role="menuitem"`, `tabindex="-1"` (roving focus) | A `Button` inside the `Menu` | `DropdownMenuItem` |
| Single-select row | `role="menuitemradio"` with `aria-checked`, inside `role="group"` labelled by its section header | A `Picker` inside the `Menu`, or `Toggle`; VoiceOver reads "Selected" | `DropdownMenuItem` with `Modifier.selectable(role = Role.RadioButton)` |
| Section header | Labels its `role="group"` with `aria-labelledby`; not focusable | `Section("Sort by")` | Plain text with `heading()` semantics, not focusable |
| Divider | `role="separator"` | `Divider()` or a `Section` break | `HorizontalDivider()` |
| Submenu row | `role="menuitem"` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` | A nested `Menu` | Opens a nested `DropdownMenu`; announce "submenu" in `stateDescription` |
| Shortcut meta | `aria-keyshortcuts="Meta+D"` on the row; the visible text is `aria-hidden` | – | – |
| Destructive row | The label says what is lost. No extra role | `Button(role: .destructive)` | Label only |
| Disabled row | `aria-disabled="true"`, still reachable by arrow keys | `.disabled(true)`, read as "dimmed" | `enabled = false` |
| Icons, chevron, check glyph | `aria-hidden="true"` | Hidden | `contentDescription = null` |

**Keyboard (web).** This follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern.

- Down and Up arrows move the highlight and wrap at the ends. Home and End jump to the first and last row.
- Typing a letter moves to the next row that starts with it.
- Enter or Space activates the row.
- Right arrow opens a submenu, and Left arrow closes it.
- Esc closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger. Tab closes the menu and moves focus on.
- Disabled rows are reached but do nothing.

**Touch target.** A Comfortable row is at least 48 tall and as wide as the panel, which is at least 200. Compact rows are 36 tall and are not for touch.

## Platform mapping

| | Android | iOS | Web |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | Material 3 `DropdownMenu` and `DropdownMenuItem`, restyled with the menu tokens: container colour, shape, shadow, and item padding and height | SwiftUI `Menu`, or `UIMenu` on UIKit. The system draws the panel, so the tokens apply only to a custom popover such as the Sort by dropdown | A `Menu` component on a popover primitive (Radix `DropdownMenu`, React Aria `Menu` or Floating UI) that handles placement, flipping, focus and dismissal |
| Destructive | `colors = MenuDefaults.itemColors(textColor = …)` with the destructive tokens | `Button(role: .destructive)`, which the system colours red | `data-destructive` styled with the destructive tokens |
| Single-select | `trailingIcon` shows the check on the selected item | `Picker` with `.pickerStyle(.menu)` | `DropdownMenu.RadioGroup` / `RadioItem`, or `menuitemradio` |
| Submenu | A second `DropdownMenu` anchored to the item, or replace the items in place on phones | A nested `Menu` | A `Sub` / `SubTrigger` / `SubContent` |
| Shortcut | – | `.keyboardShortcut` on iPad and Mac | Meta text plus `aria-keyshortcuts` |

## Known gaps

- **No component shadow token.** A component shadow needs the linter change in PR #63 (Segmented control), which had not merged when this was built. The panel uses the semantic `shadow.overlay` directly: in code, and as the `shadow/overlay` effect style in Figma. Add a menu shadow token that aliases `shadow.overlay` once #63 is on main.
- **No motion tokens.** The transitions above are documented, not tokenised.
- **The panel does not hug text in Figma.** Rows are 240 wide masters that fill the panel, so a new Menu instance starts 258 wide, not at the width of its longest label. Resize the panel between 200 and 320; the rows follow.
- **Open shows no chevron by default.** Figma booleans share one default across a set, so the Open variant cannot switch its chevron on by itself. Turn on Show chevron on submenu rows.
- **Only one trailing part at a time is enforced by convention.** Figma booleans cannot express "one of". Show meta, chevron or check, not two.
- **No dark mode.** All variable collections are single-mode.
- **Not uSpec-generated.** This file is hand-authored next to the Figma build.
